import json, sys, random, cProfile, pstats, io
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tests')
import importlib.util
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('m', '/workspace/submission/main.py')
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)

def make(natoms=8, plen=16, seed=11, nq=64, qlen=120):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    toks = ['t0', 't1']
    atoms=[]; seen=set()
    while len(atoms) < natoms:
        p = tuple(rng.choice(toks) for _ in range(plen))
        if p not in seen: seen.add(p); atoms.append(p)
    rules=[{'action':'allow','when':{'op':'and','args':[{'op':'contains','path':list(p)} for p in atoms]}}]
    q=[[toks[(i+j)%2] for j in range(qlen)] for i in range(nq)]
    return {'services': toks, 'rules': rules, 'queries': q}

req = make()
line = json.dumps(req).encode()
pr = cProfile.Profile()
pr.enable()
out = m.process(line)
pr.disable()
s = io.StringIO()
ps = pstats.Stats(pr, stream=s).sort_stats('cumulative')
ps.print_stats(14)
print(s.getvalue()[:3000])
EOF
